steps.name: Check Architectures
steps.prompt: Review the architecture diagrams in docs/architectures/ to understand the system design relevant to this task. List any dependencies or constraints.

steps.name: Write Unit Tests
steps.prompt: Write failing unit tests for the feature before implementing. Tests should cover the expected behavior described in the task.

steps.name: Implement Feature
steps.prompt: Implement the feature to make the tests pass. Follow existing code patterns and conventions.

steps.name: Run Linters
steps.prompt: Run linting, type checking, and fix any issues. Ensure code quality standards are met.

steps.name: Update Documentation
steps.prompt: Update relevant documentation and architecture diagrams based on the changes made. Add comments where necessary.
